_comment: FA-07 gate 10 (omega#26) producer claim for 0.2.0-rc15. Input to omega script/review-omega-candidate. The reviewer recomputes every value below from the artifact and the installed application; it never reads the producer's evidence. A gap is stated in _producerIdentityGap rather than papered over.
_whyThisCandidateExists: 0.2.0-rc13 shipped, and 0.2.0-rc14 was cut, on omega-effectd rc.9 -- an engine in which a Full Auto run nobody is watching never reaches its second turn. rc14 is a one-line version bump that leaves the engine pin on rc.9, whose source commit predates the fix, so installing rc14 and re-driving gate 2 would have reproduced rc13's red exactly. rc15 is the first candidate carrying openagents 5d260cbc00.
_producerIdentityGap: No producer keypair is registered anywhere in AUTHORITY.md; producers hold role operating_agent, not a key. script/review-omega-candidate only refuses when the reviewer key appears in producerPubkeys, so a producer that named itself dishonestly would pass that check. The identifier below is descriptive, not cryptographic. Naming this rather than minting a plausible-looking hex string, because a fake pubkey here would make the independence check look stronger than it is.
